title: Single-cell atlas of the human brain vasculature across development, adulthood and disease [meningioma subset, scRNA-seq]

publications.title: Single-cell atlas of the human brain vasculature across development, adulthood and disease.

institution: University College London (contact institution per GEO; multi-site collaboration per publication)
platform: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Reagent Kit v2 (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, GPL24676)
processed_data_format: 10x Genomics filtered count matrix per sample (barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz)
needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-16), closing out a coverage_gaps.md-carried lead ('GSE256490-GSE256493 ... Not yet checked. Needs the same per-sample-metadata check as the E-MTAB entries above before it can be included or excluded'). This is a pan-CNS-vasculature single-cell atlas (GSE256493 SuperSeries: 606,380 endothelial/perivascular cells from 117 samples across fetal brain, adult temporal-lobe controls, and five vascular-dependent pathologies -- AVM, lower/higher-grade glioma, lung-cancer brain metastasis, and meningioma). Per docs/scope.md's explicit pan-atlas rule ('where a pan-tumor atlas contains a meningioma subset, that subset IS in scope'), only the meningioma-labeled subset is extracted here, as its own record, not the whole atlas. Identified via scripts/extract_gsm_characteristics.py's per-sample fallback (family.soft parsed cleanly, no size issue) across GSE256490 (71 samples total): the per-GSM 'genotype' characteristic labels exactly 8 samples 'Meningioma', spanning 5 distinct patients per each sample's own 'treatment' field/title (MEN_patient1 through MEN_patient5) -- patients 1 and 2 have only a FACS-sorted CD31+/CD45- endothelial-cell (EC) sample each, while patients 3-5 each have both an EC sample and an unsorted 'all cells' (endothelial + perivascular) sample, accounting for 2+2+2+1+1=8. The sibling GSE256491 ('Extra Individuals') subseries was also checked and has zero meningioma-labeled samples among its 16. SCOPE CAVEAT, stated plainly: these are FACS-sorted/unsorted endothelial and perivascular cells isolated FROM resected meningioma tumor specimens, not meningothelial tumor cells themselves -- vascular/stromal tumor-microenvironment cells, consistent with how this inventory already treats TME cell populations captured within an in-scope tumor specimen (e.g. the macrophage/fibroblast clusters already present in this corpus's other scRNA-seq records), not a normal/reference-tissue baseline (which would route to /data/adjacent/ instead). Publication (PMID 38987604, Nature 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41586-024-07493-y) verified via PubMed esummary; retraction/correction status checked (none found). Sole corresponding author confirmed as Thomas Wälchli via the open-access PMC full text's (PMC11324530) author-notes contrib-group xref to the correspondence footnote ('_fncrsp93pmc__'), cross-checked against the live GEO record's own Sample_contact_name ('Thomas,,Wälchli') -- exact match. Full author list (37 names) taken from PubMed esummary directly, not truncated. Full-text data-availability statement confirmed citing GSE256493 (the SuperSeries covering this record). Cross-linked to the sibling bulk RNA-seq meningioma-subset record (gse-256492-brain-vasculature-bulk-rnaseq) via paired_multimodal; patient-identity correspondence between the two subseries' patient-numbering (MEN_patient1-5 here vs. MEN_patient1-6 in the bulk arm) is a reasonable but unconfirmed inference -- no explicit shared patient-ID field links the two subseries, so this is flagged rather than asserted as certain. No per-sample sex/age/grade/anatomic-location/treatment-timing data exists in either subseries' GSM metadata, so those fields correctly remain 'Not reported'. found_via is pan_atlas_check only (single path, Tier 2) since this was surfaced by the pan-cancer/pan-tissue atlas check already documented in docs/coverage_gaps.md, not independently corroborated via a second search method this pass.
